user.title: Add a GO DAIKIN air conditioner
user.description: Sign in with your GO DAIKIN account to fetch the unit's local key, or enter a key you already have. After setup, all control stays on your local network.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in with GO DAIKIN account

cloud.title: GO DAIKIN account
cloud.description: Your credentials are used once to fetch the per-unit key and are not stored.

host.title: Network address
host.description: IP address of {thing_name} on your network. Pre-filled when the unit answered discovery; otherwise find it in your router and consider a DHCP reservation.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: The unit key is the 32-character hex key the GO DAIKIN cloud assigns to this unit.

reauth_confirm.title: Unit key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: {thing_name} no longer accepts its key. Sign in again to fetch the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, that the unit is on your network, and that TCP port 7002 is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_key: The unit answered but the reply could not be decrypted. The key is wrong or has changed.
error.no_units: No units with a key were found on this account.
error.unit_not_in_account: This unit is not paired with that account.

abort.all_configured: Every unit on this account is already configured.
